  • A rule per Subtype › Item names the member; with no rule the mode decides.

The service catalogue

System administrators
  • Load the Dada PSA template adds the starter catalogue; it never overwrites.
  • A pair can carry a priority floor and require approval.
  • Retire rather than delete; tickets keep what they had.
People

Members and security roles

System administrators
Try it: what each starter role opens

A role never widens a board. Tickets are still governed by board membership, and a restricted board stays members-only.

  • Deactivate someone who has left: it takes them off every board and future rota slot, and says what it did.
  • Each person's hours a week sets their utilisation.
People

Departments

System administrators
  • The list arrives as a one-column CSV from payroll (no people), or is typed by hand.
  • A department with no board ticked lands on the unrouted queue.
  • The approver receives that department's approvals.
Clocks

Calendars and holidays

System administrators
  • A blank start or end closes the day; 24:00 is midnight at its end.
  • A holiday may close part of a day.
  • Calendars are retired, never deleted.
